description:
Functional specifications/files: add table-driven base64 materialize/2 cases in test/zaq/ingestion/record_source_test.exs before production changes. Test Google Doc -> DOCX, Sheet -> XLSX, Slides -> PPTX with extensionless downloaded names and exported MIME; repeat key cases with stale .pdf/.txt source extensions. Assert exact Path.extname, decoded bytes, original record, processor metadata and cleanup root. Cover downloaded compatible filename winning, incompatible downloaded suffix losing to MIME, PDF with nil/empty/extensionless name, ordinary .docx unchanged, source-only flat base64 disk fallback, absent/blank/octet-stream MIME with/without usable names, unknown specific MIME -> .bin even with stale source .docx, unsafe suffix rejection, MIME parameters/case and uppercase filename normalization. First run focused tests on unchanged production; capture assertion failures for Google exports and conflicts (controls may already pass). Do not call RED established for compile/setup errors. Mocking: reuse process-private exact-event NodeRouterMock at existing cross-role boundary, keep Materialization and filesystem real; register on_exit cleanup only for roots created by each test. Documentation: test names and Beadwork RED evidence; no docs behavior claims before GREEN. RED is an intentional TDD checkpoint, not a separately mergeable delivery: record observed assertion failures before advancing to helper/integration work in the same implementation change. Required passing validation applies to the completed GREEN change; never merge a failing test-only change. Action reuse assessment: extend Zaq.Ingestion.RecordSource staging policy; local-only pure MIME helper. Inspected RecordSource.materialize/2 -> store_download/2 -> TemporaryMaterializationStore.write_original/3, Materialization.materialize/4, Agent.Tools.DataSource.DownloadDocument Action, workflow steps, and all MIME/extension references under lib/zaq. DownloadDocument redeems content and does not own ingestion filenames; DiskBridge MIME.from_path/1 infers MIME in the opposite direction. No existing ZAQ MIME-to-extension abstraction found. Reuse installed MIME 2.0.7 mapping. Inputs are original/downloaded Record metadata; output is a safe extension. Preserve signed-handle authorization, actor context, download errors, bytes, original record/provenance, temporary-root lifecycle and row/plain-text .md paths. No new Action, tool, workflow surface, runtime configuration or external dependency seam. Verify through materialize/2 and pure helper tests.

Exact initial RED fixtures (all binary downloads use attributes encoding=base64 and assert decoded bytes through materialize/2):
1. Source name Budget (no suffix), source MIME application/vnd.google-apps.document; downloaded name Budget (also no suffix), MIME application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document: current .bin, expected .docx.
2. Same shape with source MIME application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet and downloaded MIME application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet: current .bin, expected .xlsx.
3. Same shape with source MIME application/vnd.google-apps.presentation and downloaded MIME application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation: current .bin, expected .pptx.
4. Source Report.pdf, downloaded Report.docx with DOCX MIME: current .pdf, expected .docx. Also source Report.txt with extensionless download and DOCX MIME: current .txt, expected .docx. These independently establish artifact-filename priority and downloaded-MIME priority over stale source suffix.
5. Source Report (no suffix), downloaded Report.pdf but DOCX MIME: current .pdf, expected .docx, establishing downloaded filename compatibility checking.
6. Source Report (no suffix), downloaded name Report or empty string and PDF MIME: current .bin, expected .pdf. Do not confuse this with existing nil-downloaded-name PDF test, which already passes.
Passing controls: ordinary .docx; extensionless source plus correctly named downloaded .docx/.xlsx/.pptx; PDF with nil downloaded name and extensionless source; application/octet-stream with no usable suffix -> .bin; existing flat disk source-extension fallback. Never claim these controls reproduce the defect.
These failures are predicted directly from current extension_for/2 and extension_from_record/1 clauses; no tests have been added/run during planning. At implementation, record actual focused assertion failures before touching production.
title: [#568] RED: reproduce artifact-extension precedence failures
